definition.BULL: All BULL_R4 candidates whose trail_arm_roe ordinal index differs by at most one and whose trail_giveback_roe ordinal index differs by at most one.
definition.RANGE: All RANGE_R4 candidates whose trail_arm_roe ordinal index differs by at most one and whose trail_giveback_roe ordinal index differs by at most one.
definition.BEAR: All BEAR_R4 failure-only candidates whose failure_h, failure_max_return, and failure_max_bb_improvement ordinal indices each differ by at most one.
definition.pass_basis: raw lane gate before plateau; no result may count itself as a pass unless it independently passes every non-plateau gate
